title: Seedance 2.0 Enhance: a ref2v recipe mode that keeps the @ reference tags
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-985. Enhance on a Seedance ref2v prompt falls back to the t2v mode, which forbids @image1/@video1/@audio1, so it can drop the tags MPI-910 shipped. Add a ref2v mode to js/data/recipes/seedance-2.0.recipe.js from the Higgsfield skills (private/seedance-skills/), fix the case-sensitive tag ban, de-stale Cosmo's Seedance guide. No paid video render.
